note: Design (read 11-18): TextureStore::stage_image runs detail::authored_levels (texture_store.cpp:476; an RGBA expansion of the first level and four box-filter comparisons per texel) for every record the cook did not flag NEBULA_TEXTURE_GENERATED_LEVELS, before the drop branch, so every budget restage (:623, drop > 0) runs it again. The answer is a property of the record's bytes: the cook (crates/nebula-import/src/cook/texture.rs) decides it once and writes NEBULA_TEXTURE_AUTHORED_LEVELS (flags bit 1) with the store form change E13a stage 4b already makes (store 37); the runtime reads the bit. An image with no cook behind it (a mod's, handed at run time) is judged once when it is registered and the answer kept in its entry, so a restage reads it. Proof: the import check runs both judges (the cook's Rust and the runtime's C++) over every texture of the three discs and requires the same answer; a counter in the texture-store test: a restage makes no judgement; pictures the same.

title: (wrong picture, memory): NebulaIcons paints the picture font's sharp sheets one after another into one record (sHd.mRecord, malloc at NebulaIcons.cpp:1826, unchecked, as :1827 and :2038) and hands each to the host (:1857). The API says the renderer takes a copy (nebula_game_api.h:1019); it stages one and also keeps the pointer (texture_store.cpp:593), and a device restart stages every kept record again from it (:335-337), so every sheet then shows what the record holds last. The Joy-Con picture sets are freed 250 ms of wall clock after they stop being shown (cJcRetireMs, NebulaIcons.cpp:2078, :2490), not when the frames drawing them are done.
note: Found by the readall harness's Game/Screen report (11-18, read at 0c98b11c2) and checked by reading every line cited at 241395b49. Fix: one record per sheet kept while it is handed over (or the store keeps its own copy, as the API says); the Joy-Con sets retired at the render side's frame fence; allocation failures checked. Not settled: whether a retired Joy-Con set's images are released to the store before its block is freed (the store also keeps game images by pointer for a restart, texture_store.cpp:514, :326-333).
